intro: After 2, 3 and 4 the noun usually goes in genitive singular; after 5 or more, in genitive plural.

bloques.titulo: After 2, 3 and 4 the noun usually goes in genitive singular; after 5 or more, in genitive plural.
texto: After 2, 3 and 4 the noun usually goes in genitive singular; after 5 or more, in genitive plural.

opciones.explicacion: After пять the plural genitive is used.
